original_test_intent: Verify the approved Mellanox CX7 cable/connector pair can be safely disengaged and re-seated without mechanical damage and that the mapped CX7 port/device returns with correct enumeration, link and error-free operation.
original_method: Identify cable part/serial, both endpoints and port mapping; inspect latch, pins, shell, bend radius and routing; place system/link in vendor-approved powered or unpowered service state; qualified operator performs the approved single remove/reinsert cycle without force; photograph full latch/seating; after settle, compare PCIe/network/HCA inventory, link width/rate/state and error counters/logs to baseline.
manual_activity: Qualified operator inspects and services the named CX7 cable; agent may collect post-cycle enumeration/link/error evidence.
required_inputs: CX7 adapter/port and cable part/serial/end-to-end map
Connector/latch/vendor insertion-removal procedure and hot-plug support
Approved service power/link state, cycle count and settle timeout
Expected seating indicators, device identity, link width/rate/state and error tolerances
safety_requirements: Use ESD controls and vendor-required power state
Inspect connector/pins and stop on damage, misalignment or excessive force
Preserve cable routing/bend radius and workload/link recovery
Do not repeat insertion to force recovery or clear baseline logs
agent_execution_scope: Capture pre/post device, link, HCA and error evidence
Correlate operator photos and cycle timestamps
Do not touch cable, decide hot-plug safety, infer seating from software alone, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Define objective mechanical seating/removal criteria and cycle count
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command can verify latch feel, pin condition or physical seating; software checks only confirm post-cycle function.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect mapped CX7 PCIe/HCA/network identity, negotiated link and counters before and after the operator cycle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Ease of one plug cycle, proper seating and error-free redetection remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind physical connector inspection and latch evidence to the exact port's pre/post enumeration, link and error-counter comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces subjective 'easy' with approved force/latch/damage criteria and adds exact identity/service state.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A device may remain visible through another path or degraded link despite incomplete seating.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unsupported hot removal can damage hardware or disrupt traffic; link recovery alone cannot reveal bent pins or poor retention.

project_override_considerations: If the assembly is not field-removable or hot-pluggable, perform only the vendor-qualified powered-down procedure; do not interpret 'easy' as authority to force the connector.
expected_evidence: Approved service state and cycle timestamps
Pre/post device/HCA/link width-rate-state and error/log diff
Final seating/link health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require physical CX7 cable service, proper seating and error-free redetection.

blocked_analysis.analysis: This is valid manual hardware work when the connector procedure and qualified operator are available.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2268 Wistron-HW-00024-V003: approve CX7 adapter/port plus cable part/serial and endpoint map; vendor latch/insertion/removal procedure, supported powered/hot-plug versus powered-down state, cycle count, objective force/seating/damage/routing criteria and settle timeout; define expected PCIe/HCA/network identity, link width/rate/state, error counters/logs and recovery/final state.

review_improvement: Preserves the mechanical plug-cycle intent while binding physical seating to the correct CX7 port's complete functional recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: 'Easy to plug and unplug' is subjective and may encourage force unless converted to the vendor latch and damage criteria. A CX7 path can enumerate yet negotiate a degraded width/rate, or traffic can fail despite presence. Conversely redundant paths can hide failure. The review therefore requires exact endpoint identity, qualified service state, visual/mechanical evidence and port-specific enumeration, link and counter comparison after one controlled cycle.
